name: 11414 · Howard Beach, NY
findings: ZIP 11414 (Howard Beach) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11414 (Howard Beach) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
94% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
